format: ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION from quantization-aware distillation (BF16 teacher, 1.26B tokens): MLP and lm_head NVFP4 W4A16 (group 16) in every layer, Gated DeltaNet projections NVFP4 in 38 of 48 layers and FP8 per-tensor in the other 10 (0-2, 4, 5, 57, 58, 60-62), attention projections FP8 per-tensor
why: NVIDIA's own quantization is preferred, as for the pair's checkpoint, and this one is distilled: the NVFP4 weights were trained against the BF16 model's token distributions (1.26B tokens), so they track it more closely than one-shot calibration. On 224 held-out documents its next-token KL to BF16 is 0.069 as served here, against 0.096 for nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 with TandemLLM's projections, lower on 211 of them (results/2026-11-20-27b-qad). Ungated; governed by the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement (the Qwen3.8-27B base is Apache-2.0); context up to 262K tokens per its card.

draft.why: The published DFlash2 block drafter for Qwen3.8-27B. Atlas verifies its blocks exactly, so it changes speed, not text.

overlay.why: TandemLLM's NVFP4 Gated DeltaNet and attention projections, quantized once from Qwen's BF16 release with GPTQ on about 150K tokens, laid only over the projections the checkpoint stores in FP8: the ten GDN layers 0-2, 4, 5, 57, 58, 60-62 and all sixteen attention layers. The checkpoint's own NVFP4 GDN layers are kept. Every projection is then NVFP4, so a decode step reads the same bytes as with the earlier checkpoint; the checkpoint's FP8 GDN served natively would add about 0.5 GB a step, and re-rounding it and the attention to NVFP4 at load costs more KL (0.078) than these weights (0.069). Weights only; no TandemLLM code is used.

dspine.why: Tencent's DSpine block drafter for Qwen3.8-27B: 16-row blocks whose layers each pass a row its predecessor's predicted feature, so it guesses much further ahead on code, JSON and tool calls (8.4 tokens a round on the code probe against DFlash2's 6.1). Atlas verifies its blocks exactly, so it changes speed, not text. DRAFTER=dspine serves it alone; DRAFTER=both serves it beside DFlash2, each request on whichever its recent rounds favour.

daisyrose.format: The same ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION layout as nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4: all 2,194 tensors match it in name, dtype and shape, and the chat template is byte-identical.
daisyrose.why: RadixArk's reinforcement-learning finetune of Qwen3.8-27B (no SFT or distillation), served with CHECKPOINT=daisyrose with its own overlay: TandemLLM's NVFP4 projections are quantized from base Qwen and would undo part of the finetune. The drafters were trained on base Qwen; verify stays exact, so they change only how often drafts are accepted.

overlay.label: Enntity
overlay.why: Our NVFP4 Gated DeltaNet and attention projections, GPTQ-quantized from DaisyRose's BF16 release (620K calibration tokens in its chat template; damping 0.1, per-16 scales over 0.80-1.75 x amax/6) in TandemLLM's layout. In place of the checkpoint's FP8 GDN and the engine's load-time NVFP4 attention: decode 43.7 -> 50.2 tok/s on one Spark at +0.0020 nats/token held-out NLL, quality probe level (results/2026-11-19-daisyrose-projections).
